integrity: The covariance correction follows from the Itô covariance equation for the source's printed linearization. The baseline equilibrium, Jacobian, independent covariance, adjoint Lyapunov equation, affine trace coefficients, and sharp endpoint values are independently reconstructed in the bundled standard-library checker.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the first-order weak-noise stochastic-sensitivity covariance near the stable endemic equilibrium.
Only the trace of the correlation-dependent covariance is optimized; determinant and individual principal-axis extrema are not classified.
The sharp extrema are attained at singular but valid correlation matrices and can be approximated by nonsingular correlations.
No claim is made about exact nonlinear stationary covariance at finite noise or about the source's independent-noise extinction and persistence theorems.
title: Correct correlated-noise sensitivity and a sharp covariance envelope in a stochastic SIRS model
